mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, nickname, phone, email, avatar, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())

SELECT * FROM user WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 1
